Worked examples

Each example has a netlist in examples/. You can load it from the Examples… menu or with Open….

Every number quoted in these pages was computed with the engine itself, and most are checked against a closed-form result. Where they come from a finer sweep than the netlist's default, that is noted. The scripts behind them use tools/measure.mjs, and the figures are regenerated by tools/docfigs.py.

# Example What it shows
1 Quarter-wave transformers First netlist, single lines, two networks in one file, bandwidth check against the closed form
2 Coupled-line couplers Zeo, even/odd modes, quadrature and directivity traces, inhomogeneous media, compensating with lumped capacitors and the optimiser
3 Comb-line filter, spec to loss budget Synthesis by hand and with the tool, refinement, polishing, insertion loss from Q, spurious passband
4 Interdigital filter by hand Writing the design equations as .params, Cg/Cm, tapped sections, comparing hand design with refined synthesis
5 Marchand balun Multi-section topology with wire, balance traces, Z0e/Z0o design trade-off
6 Schiffman 90° phase shifter C-section with joined ends, phase-difference traces, .goal with =
7 Three-line section from C and L matrices General inhomogeneous input from a field solver, reading the modal analysis
8 From a coupler netlist to a KiCad board Layout panel, converting impedances to microstrip, physical view of the as-built board, substrate vs connector trade-off, KiCad export
9 Comb-line filter: from a specification to Gerbers Physical synthesis with SMD capacitors, tap T-junctions, comb-line layout, as-built vs design, KiCad board with capacitor footprints and via fence, Gerbers in CI
10 Hairpin and edge-coupled filters from one specification The folded and the straight form of the parallel-coupled filter: synthesis, the 2f0 spurious passband, layout, size and skirts as built
11 A duplexer from a specification to Gerbers Two filters on a synthesised manifold, open-circuit branch lengths, the isolation budget, layout with mirrored filters, KiCad
12 A compact Wilkinson and a branch-line hybrid, to Gerbers Arm coupling in a compact Wilkinson (ignored vs modelled), chip isolation resistors, a branch-line with tee corners, KiCad
13 Checking a coupler in openEMS Full-wave export, the comparison at the same reference planes, where the two differ (dispersion, the layout's corners and arms, radiation), mesh convergence and grading; the compact Wilkinson's unmodelled output coupling
14 A velocity-equalised coupler with interdigital fingers Finger-loaded coupled lines designed against openEMS: Bloch de-embedding of εe, εo, Newton–Broyden design, a 15 dB coupler with 23 dB directivity (plain: 9 dB), against end-capacitor compensation, and why 10 dB does not fit at 0.09 mm spacing

If you are new to the tool, do 1 → 2 → 4 → 3 in that order. Example 3 assumes you have seen how the closed form in Example 4 works.
